experiments.scope: The blake3-r2-prefix-v1 target. Each trial executes the search of proof.md 9.1, 9.8 and 9.9 on the priced instance (flags 3, counter t by step CT) for one context: seven outer words and eight members from the seed, the test of W, the 39 context lines; per member its walk of seven full blocks of 2^16 steps (t_hi below 2^19), each of constant X0 >> 16 with the level-16 test of automaton (2); per live block the first eight words of the list of its state cut for the member's class (Lemma CP), with the packed Y9 fill, the exact 6-unit packed Y9 prefilter of Lemma PF (a word with no lane satisfying (Y9_lo + 0x044) & 0x387 == 0 is skipped), the T1 replicas and the word test on kept words; per passing lane the shortcut, the pre-check of 9.7, the preflight, the joint screen of 9.9 and the joint solver of 9.4 with (G7) and (G15), with the root predicate; for a certified root, both last-chunk compressions at counter t and the 256-bit test. In-run checks: those of proof.md 9.2, with every 61st skipped word re-tested with T1 (uncharged; a pass is a mismatch). The returned pair is built by steps CO and CT on the harness instance (counter 0, flags 11, t_hi = 0) for the trial's context and first passing member. No BLAKE3 library. Hashes stated before the run of PREREG6W4 (H_PF (a) for the 6-unit prefilter and MU on the class-list walk, 16,384 whole contexts, seeds 540,672 to 557,055): plan SHA-256 72a5d11bacfad8f78f0ce726bc68333dbace499ab5bff8f088df00f194ebea80; shipped program experiments/frontline.py SHA-256 9831feeaeb0b3e72bda8f4f07c31fc0cd29256a2d75b75ed710a3ed68f5fc856. Earlier PREREG6W3 (H_PF (b) on the class-list walk, 262,144 whole contexts): plan SHA-256 32298b5dd4787a45d96007ea5928197e7d476b24d07e69d9ff9b771c43ebdae6; program SHA-256 c7c94d6da889bc91061713741741813283c26fb86726480a71cf95d8f9ad56b8.
experiments.hypothesis: For every trial the two complete 2-round digests (counter 0, flags 11) agree on digest words 0, 2, 5 and 7, the 128 masked bits: after the first half of round 2 the two states differ only in Y3 and Y11, and the only differing message word of the diagonal step is w5; none enters diagonals 0 and 2. The 16 observations are the program's own counts, untrusted: blocks, live, ranges, words, e_lanes (kept words' lanes), passes, prechecked, solver_calls, roots, certified, units, solver_units, checks, mismatches, halted, live_steps. Expected per trial (outcome set S of three rows, proof.md 9.10): 56 blocks, about 3.6 live, 28 words of which about 3 kept (about 20 E lanes), 0.4 passes, 0.1 prechecked and 0.015 solver calls, almost always no root; mismatches and halted 0. The counter instance cannot be digest-checked by the organizer; the run is not evidence of attack cost. The member reads the list of its class (kept words, E_KEPT = 24345360). Preregistrations PREREG6W4, PREREG6W3, PREREG6W2 and PREREG6W are recorded in the first section of proof.md.
